title: Cub Creek Foundation Artist-in-Residence Program
source_quote: The Artist-In-Residence program at Cub Creek Foundation provides emerging and established artists with the time, space, and facilities to pursue individual development... experiment with atmospheric firing
evidence_sentence: The residency page states residents participate in group firings and are expected to help with wood preparation.
evidence_quote: participate in resident meetings - once a month... Help with wood preparation once a week
summary: A residency for emerging and established artists lasting one month to three years, providing studio space, housing, and participation in communal wood firings for $1,100/month plus security deposit and cleaning fee.
how_to_join: Email Heidi at hkreitchet@gmail.com with arrival and departure dates and submit application materials (10-20 images, artist statement, bio, letter of intent, and $25 fee).
cost_text: $1,100/month, $200 refundable security deposit, $100 non-refundable cleaning fee, $25 application fee
